terra.problem: The passage says the people honor God with their lips, but it does not say their lips are close to Him.
The text does not say that nobody is clapping. That detail is presented as a fact about the scene.
Jesus does not say that what enters the mouth cannot reach the heart, or that this is His whole point. The explanation turns His contrast into an unsupported anatomical claim.
Even marked as a guess, saying the list is meant to make us look inward assigns a purpose to Jesus' words that the passage does not state.
